batting.name: Yuvraj Singh
batting.dismissal: c RN ten Doeschate b JH Kallis

batting.name: G Gambhir
batting.dismissal: c Yuvraj Singh b IC Pandey

batting.name: MK Tiwary
batting.dismissal: c MK Pandey b B Kumar

batting.name: R Bhatia
batting.dismissal: run out (LJ Wright, RV Uthappa, AD Mathews)

balls.text: full-toss and that's been straight to the long-on fielder! it was a good, juicy delivery to be spanked over the fence but does not get it off the middle and it's easily caught
and now outside the off yet again, drilled through to wide long-off for a couple of runs
and now Yuvi has blasted it over long-off for a six, was a fuller delivery outside the off stump and he punches it off the middle and over long-off

outside the off stump, was looking to open the face of the bat but this is slower and beats his outside edge, the keeper throws it back to the bowler even as Yuvraj wants to take a single, Kallis gathers it well and throws down the stumps at the non-striker's end, end of a superb innings
and now on the other side, he was looking to go away to the off side and gets another full-toss, tapped through the leg side for a four again
wow, that's classy, it was a fuller delivery outside the off stump, he gets it off a deft opening of the face of the bat through to fine third-man for a four
very full from Narine, almost beats him, digs it out and the inside edge gets him a couple of runs through fine-leg
shorter in length and nudged it away to long-on for a single
goes for a sweep and mis-hits it, it's come off the top edge and floated up for a long time, falls in no-man land at deep cover
shorter, wider and thumped by Yuvraj, gets a couple of runs to the left of the deep cover fielder
and another one, more deliberate this time, almost like he wanted to run it through the slips, gets it to the very fine, short third-man
outside edge and that's gone away through slips for a four, he was looking to play it over the leg side but gets nowhere near the middle, through to the fence
shorter in length, slower too and Yuvraj looked like he knew what was coming, waited and then smacked, the long-on was wider and he's hit it straighter and beaten that fielder
wider again but in the block-hole, opens the face of the bat and guides it to short third-man
shorter, wider and there was no fielder at third-man, easily opens the face of the bat and gets it over the in-fielders to get to his 50!
and now smashes it over the bowler's head, gets a single and a bit of a misfield allows them to get back for the second
outside the off and he's scooped it over the off side for a four, gets it over extra cover that
fuller outside the off stump and tapped away to the off side for a single
is that dropped? yes it it, outside the off and he was looking to steer it down, gets an edge and Bisla floors it
and now beats him, it's fuller and he's looking to defend at it, beats the outside edge
that's half-swept, half-slogged and it's been hit away over mid-wicket
shorter in length and pulled away to long-on for a single
was looking to unwind but it comes on quickly outside the off stump and he cuts it to point
fuller on the off stump and turning back into the batsman, defended off the front foot
and again, he continues to slow his pace down, was shorter in length too, hits it hard into the ground and back to the bowler.
on his pads and slows it down, was looking to paddle it round the corner, gets the toe of the bat and it rolls over to the leg side
outside the off stump and driven to the off side for a single
shorter in length and on his pads, wants to cramp him up and Yuvraj nudges it away for a single
fuller in length and slower too, 94 km/hr, driven to long-on for a single
again some room but taps it to the off side for a single
three in a row! Kallis has gone for a lot of runs in both his last two overs, it was shorter in length and cut away over point for a four
and this time he gets it over fine-leg for a four, it was shorter in length and he goes across to the off stump and shows some flair in getting off the short fine-leg fielder
pressure-reliever, it was short of length outside the off and he was looking to give himself room, does that well and cracks it past point for a four
and swings it yet again, misses for the second time, this was slightly slower and beats him
looks to go across and pull it over fine-leg and misses, the ump declares that a wide though
inside edge and that's bounced over the stumps to the keeper
shorter in length and he cuts it, tries to cut it hard but gets an inside edge to point
a pre-meditated sweep from Yuvraj leads to the outside edge beaten, he was ready with the shot even before he had delivered
defended to the off side, a tad more carefully this time
whoa, what a ball! it was on the off stump and turning away, looking to defend off the front foot and beats the outside edge, beaten!
on his pads, quicker and that's chipped to the leg side for a single
turn and a lot of it, back into the batsman, but it was slow turn and he was able to defend it back
shorter in length and punched to the short cover, straight to him
bowled him, Balaji has one, it was shorter in length and the batsman was looking to pull it away, the ball seems to have kept a tad low, hasn't come on too quickly probably and he's bowled
wide outside the off stump again, that's good bowling against two batsmen wanting to go after him, outside edge to short third-man
wide, half volley and he drives it through the covers, seems like it came off the bottom of the bat and he's signalling at the dugout for a new willow
shorter, slower and he was looking to pull it, does not get it off the middle, Pathan throws it to the bowler from square-leg and does not hit, could have been out
shorter in length and wants to crack it through the off side, gets it well but straight to the short cover fielder
very full and almost yorks the batsman, he was looking to shuffle away to the leg side but is only able to dig it out, back to the bowler
on the off stump and he opens the face yet again, pushes it to point for a single
on his pads and easily tucked away to the leg side for a single
not too short and he was looking to cut it away, gets an inside edge and to point
shorter in length and that's pushed down to long-off for a single
fuller, outside the off stump and driven down to long-off for a single
slows it down, pulls his length back and the batsman easily tucks it to deep square-leg for a single
and now it's Pandey, it's very full from Bhatia and he's slogged it over mid-wicket for a six!
on his pads and easily tucked away for a single
and gone again for a six! Finch wants to turn it on here and he's just hit his third six, it was slightly fuller, in fact on a good length and he has hit it through the line over the bowler's head
another one that never comes on but Finch awaits its arrival before cutting it in front of the covers and gets a couple
slower, shorter and he cuts it away to deep cover for a single
two in a row! that's fuller this time and Finch powers it over the long-on fence for a second six, that's turned things around for Pune there
and shot away for a six! that was an attempted yorker but went as a full-toss, Finch almost seemed like he was waiting for it and spanks him over long-on for a maximum, should help
continues the liberal use of the short ball against Pandey, who, for a change is able to pull it down to long-on for a single
shorter in length and tapped away to the leg side for a single
and now he goes to slog it away, misses and he sneaks through between the bat and the pad, there was a sound there, looks like it has hit the stump without disturbing the bail enough
shorter in length and he was looking to hit it over mid-off, the slowness of the pace means he has to check his stroke and lob it to mid-off on a bounce
slower delivery, tries the off-spinner and easily tucked away to the leg side for a single
outside the off stump and it's driven to the right of the deep cover fielder, Bhatia has to run across but cannot stop the second
slower than his normal speed, on the off stump and he works it away to long-on for a single
on a length but not too much, easily able to come down the track and push it down to long-on for a single
again a tad shorter in length and punched away to wide long-on for a single
shorter in length and almost pushed down to long-on while walking with the shot
in the air that was, on the off stump and fuller, was looking to drill it through the covers, gets an outside edge and it flies through short cover for a couple
was looking to slog it away but it comes rather slow, beats the outside of the bat and this time Bisla is quick to whip 'em off, he is in though
short of length and that's tapped back to the bowler, gets his left hand out and fields it well
on his pads, slightly quicker I think, tucked away to backward square-leg for a couple of runs
a very slow ball, fuller as well and driven down to long-off for a single
on the middle stump and on a good length, he looks to open the face of the bat and gets it away to point, wanted a single but is sent back
slower one outside the off stump and easily opens the face of the bat and hits it through to third-man for a single
and again, he looks to pull it yet again, does not look too comfortable and it rolls over to short mid-wicket, that's a good fielding position
dropped is it? no, it seems to have fallen just short of the short mid-wicket fielder, was looking to pull it but was never in control of it there
slower pitched right up to the bat and it's pushed to long-on for a single
shorter one from Kallis and he swivels around to hit it straight to deep square-leg for a single
fuller on the off stump and driven back to the bowler off the back foot
fuller and he drives it down to long-on for a single
whoa, that's close, close, close, lbw appeal, and it looks to have come off an inside edge, good umpiring!

bowled 'im! that's come off the inside edge and rattled the stumps! it was shorter in length and that pull shot was not a bad choice but it seemed to be a slower than what the batsman thought, does not get it off the middle
slower outside the off stump and Finch wants to deposit it into Eden Gardens, gets an inside edge to the deep mid-wicket fielder
quicker on his pads and wants to tap it away, beats the bat and it skids through
was going down the track and the bowler shortens the length, tapped away to the leg side
wow, what a shot, it was slightly shorter, and he's slapped it on the up and through the extra-cover region for a four to spoil what was turning out to be a good over
shorter in length and that's pulled to deep square-leg for a single

appeal for stumping and the third ump's being called here. flighted up to the bat and he was looking to drive it over the bowler's head, misses and the keeper needs some time before he dislodges the bails, by which time he's back
goes for the sweep yet again but does not get any bat on it, lobs up off the pad
ooh, very slow again, no turn and Uthappa is an hour early into his sweep, misses
outside the off stump, slows it down but no turn on that one, defended back
fuller and driven down to mid-off for a single
fuller and he stills goes back and pushes it to long-on for a single
shorter in length and cuts hard, straight to the cover fielder
that's quite full but outside the leg stump, he was looking to shimmy down the pitch but can only tap it away to mid-wicket for a single
shorter in length and that's tapped down to long-on for a single
shorter from round the stumps and he pats it to square-leg
and again, that's another six and this time he does move down the track to get create the power, it was a short of length delivery and look how he's treated it, slapped it away!
fuller this time and on the off stump, was looking to push it away and gets an inside edge to mid-wicket for a single
shorter, wider and slower outside the off stump, he wanted to give it his all, but the lack of pace defeats the shot, it isn't timed too well to the covers
and now he opens the face of the bat, guides it through to third-man for a single
short of length and this time he gets it off the middle, no moving around in the crease, just waited for it, and spank, six over mid-wicket!
goes down the track and tries to thwack it over the in field, gets nowhere near the middle of the bat and it rolls over to short mid-wicket
gets his bat and down together and pushes it to long-on for a single
and again, gives himself room, moves back and crunches it through the off side, gets it into the gap, chased and fielded well by Kallis
shortens his length expectedly and that's tapped into the covers
fuller and he gives himself some room and driven down the ground for a four!
again on his pads and that's pushed down to deep long-on for a single, the batsmen had to wait for it cross the short mid-wicket and they cannot come back
round the stumps, that's very full on his pads and easily tucked down to deep square-leg for a single
punches it off the back foot into the covers, not for runs
and that's drifted far too down his pads, easily tucked away to fine-leg for a couple of runs
brings it back to the off stump line and pulls his length back a little, defended back to the bowler
did I see a bit of swing away from the bat there, just a little bit and on a length, he only pushes forward, gets it off the middle of the bat and through the covers for a four
wide, outside the off stump and he cuts it, was trying to place it but does not get any of it, hit straight to backward point
on the off stump, good length too and he's immediately back and defending to the off side, wanted a single but the fielders converge from everywhere
another full-toss that's hit to wide long-on for a couple of runs, that means that Pune have finally won the game but more vitally, KKR have crashed out of the competition
a low full-toss outside the off stump and the only thing he can do is to hit it straight to the long-on fielder for a single

outside the off stump, and he has sliced it over to deep cover, there was an easy two there but the batsman at the striker's end did not want to, he tries to get back to the non-striker's end and despite hitting the stumps with his body, Mathews seems to have uprooted the stumps with the ball in his hands. The third ump has been called to adjudicate that one and it's out!
whoa, full-toss with the square-leg inside the circle, he was looking to pull it away and the mistimed shot goes away for a four
fuller outside the off stump and he looks to hit it over the fielder at long-on, gets a single to the wide fielder, come back for the second and the throw is a pretty bad one
wide outside the off stump, he was moving towards the ball and despite being outside that line, it's not wide enough to be called a wide
full-toss, trying hard to keep it up to the bat, was looking to pull it away, gets it as far as deep mid-wicket for a single
fuller outside the off and he gets it away straight this time, rolls over to the right of the long-off fielder and they are able to come back for the second
beaten again, was looking to dig it away but no bat on it yet again
and beats him yet again, outside the off stump, again very full and beats the outside edge, cannot get any bat
fuller outside the off stump, and he was looking to drill it away, beats the batsman
outside the off stump and that's drilled down to the deep cover for a single
full-toss and that's absolutely smashed back to the non-striker's end where the stumps are scattered by the shot, single for the batsman

whoa, what happened there! it was dug out by Pathan and he wanted to go away for a single, the non-striker wasn't coming through, the batsman was very close to where the ball was on the pitch, the bowler was trying to get close to it, Pathan taps it away with his foot, there was a definite obstruction and the question there is whether it was deliberate or not! Third umpire is having a look at it and wow, the umpire has given it out, looked more on the side of it being deliberate than inadvertent there, but YP isn't happy, he waits for a long, long time, much like Inzy Haq would after getting bowled.
back to over the wicket and outside the off stump, fuller and he was trying to drill it through the covers, beats the outside edge of the bat

top edged over the short fine-leg fielder for a four, this was another shorter one from the bowler and he was never in control of that pull, gets a top edge and easily beats the fielder inside the circle, bounces away for a four
short, angling in and that's been hit over the backward square-leg area for a six, it was in his arc and he almost gave it the direction there
crashed through the covers for a four, it was outside the off stump from round the stumps and it comes on as a full-toss, cracked away to the boundary
shorter in length, and slower too, punched down to long-on for a single, the batsman wanted a second but was sent back
fuller outside the off stump and driven through to deep covers for a single
slower one this time, was looking to open the face of the bat and guide it down to third-man, misses
through point for a four, it was a length delivery and cracks it away, Yuvraj was quite inside the circle beats his left hand

gone, Tiwary's gone caught and they have lost their fifth now! was on a length, it was swinging this at this late stage of the innings, was looking to heave over the long-on fielder, gets it on the bottom of the bat and it's gone straight to the fielder
outside the off stump, wider too and he looks to drill it over the off side, gets a bit of a slice on it and it lobs up over Yuvraj at point, was in the air for a long time
slower one and swinging away from the bat, pushes it to the covers

again on his pads and that's gone, run-out! it was on the middle-stump, was looking to flick it away and gets it to short fine-leg, the fielder was standing at the edge of the circle, the throw comes in hard and flat and the batsman is way down the track, Pathan has already refused his call for a single and there goes number four
shorter in length and adjusts his line well to outside the off stump, pushed through to deep cover for a single
bad, bad ball, it was a full-toss, on his pads and with the fine-leg up inside the circle, gets some bat on it and it flies to the fence for a four
very full outside the off stump and the drive is hit to extra-cover
very full, on the off stump and driven back to the bowler
and now he gets a four, it was an outside edge that rolls through the slip to the fence, was a shorter delivery and he went for a cut, gets it away for a four!
pushes it quicker and on the legs of the batsman for a single to fine-leg
on his pads and tucked away to the leg side for a single
was going down the track, pushed wide outside the off and he manages to get a bat on it
shorter in length and tapped to mid-wicket to get Pathan to his first IPL 50 in many, many years
shorter in length and cut away to point for a single
short of length outside the off stump and that's bounced a lot more than what he expected, beats the outside edge of the bat
bouncer, a delivery in anger and at that pace, wanted to hook it away, misses
and yet again! wow, that's effortless batting from Pathan, he was on his back foot, just went through with the shot, swing of the arms and for a four over mid-off
full-toss and that's mis-hit over the mid-off player for a four! he was looking for a yorker again but misses it and that's run away...
short of length and tapped to mid-off, the fielder is close in and that's fielded well
round the stumps and slower in pace, angling in and pushed into the covers for a single

wow, that was something, the batsman was looking to come down the track and the bowler almost stopped in his action, the batsman also stopped and the ball was then delivered, tucked away to the leg side for a single, of course all of it happened in a space of a second or two.
length ball outside the off stump and tapped down to long-off for a single
wide outside the off stump as the batsman came down the track there, gets enough of bat on it to get it to deep cover
shorter in length and that's pushed to long-off for a single
fuller, flatter, quicker, outside the off stump and tapped to the off side for a single
fuller and he chips down the wicket and easily drives it straight and for a four, bisects both the fielders at the deep boundary

now that's the heave, that was on a good length and it was almost like a last-second decision to thwack it over the mid-wicket region, it went very high and more vitally for the batsman it went long too, well done
tries to heave it over the off side but the ball keeps a little low and sneaks through to the keeper
full-toss and outside the off stump, driven to long-on for a single
shorter in length and quicker too, this is tapped to the leg side, in the gap between long-on and deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs, that's beautifully done
slower one outside the off stump and he pushes it to the off side for a single
wanted to drive it through the covers but gets an inside edge through to short fine-leg for a single
quicker this time and fuller too, pushed back to the bowler
fuller on the off stump and tapped back to long-off for a single
on his pads and that's gently nudged away to fine-leg for a single

round the wicket and angling into the batsman, he tucks it away to the leg side for a single, they come back for the second and Pandey sends down a wild throw that beats a lot of players on its way to the fence, six runs for the batsmen!
on his pads, length ball and he's had an ugly swipe at that one, gets a couple of runs to the deep square-leg regon
fuller, outside the off stump, tossed up and driven down to long-off for a single
fuller and tapped to the off side, not for runs, which means they need 97 in the last 10
very full from the bowler and he was looking to smack it away, gets an inside edge on to his boot, rolls over to the off side
lot of movement in the crease, and then a flick away to deep mid-wicket for a single
whoa, what a shot that, it was on his pads, he was looking to go down the track, does that and chips it over mid-wicket
shorter in length and wants to cut it away, misses
slower on a length and pushed back to the right of the bowler, misfielded and they get a single
on the middle stump and very full, it was straight too and he was looking to move across, gets some bat on it and rolls away for a four
fuller on his pads and tucked away to the leg side for a single
short of length and pulled away for a four between fine-leg and deep square-leg for a four, one bounce and into the hoardings
shorter and wants to cramp the batsman for room, he taps it down to long-on and they are away for a quick single
on the off stump line and shorter in length, opens the face of the bat and guides it through to third-man for a single
slower on the pads and tucked away to the leg side for a single
shorter in length and cut away to the off side for a single
on his pads, this was shorter again and tucked away to the leg side for a single
was coming down the track and he shortens the length, pushed into the covers for a single
shorter in length and tapped it away to the short covers for a quickly-taken single
on his pads and tucked away for a single to the leg side
shimmy down the pitch and drilled through the wide mid-off region, beats the fielder in the deep area, Pandey dives to his left but cannot pull it back
this guy's getting them to swing alright, this is fuller outside the off and movement away from the batsman and he defends it away
shorter in length and he opens the face of the bat and guides it through to third-man for a couple of runs, the fielder had to run across to his right there
bludgeoned away! fuller on the middle stump and he's swung it away over the bowlers head for a four!
shorter but this is a tad wider outside the off stump too and his pull shot gets the ball away to the mid-on fielder only
bit of swing away from the batsman and it's pushed into the covers for a single
up and over and that's been hit to the wide long-off area for a four, it was a good length ball and that's hit through the line and to the fence
and again, shorter in length at Pathan, this time he's sitting back and waiting, pulls it away to deep square-leg for a single
shorter in length and pulled away to the leg side for a single
slows it down greatly and he was moving down the track, checks his movement and his stroke, defends it to the leg side and wants a single but YP asks him to get back
fuller on the off stump and he defends it off the front foot, to the off side
shorter in length and wanted to pull it away, does not get it off the middle of it and trickles down to deep square-leg for a single
short, outside the off stump and he cracks it but straight to the point fielder
and was looking to smack it away but not for runs again
opens the face of the bat and guides it through to third-man for a single

walks down and he's gone, caught! trouble, trouble, that's a lot of it for KKR, GG was looking to go down the track and smack it over the in-field, again the ball seemed to have not come on too well and he only gets a top edge that spoons up gently for Yuvraj to take a straight-forward chance
shorter in length and outside the off stump, just not able to get it away as the shot rolls over to the covers
short of length and it's pulled straight to mid-on
on his pads and easily tucked away to the leg side for a four, was short and the batsman had no problem working it away with the fine-leg up in the circle

bowled him, Kallis' stumps have gone for a run there! it was a yorker-length ball, and Kallis seems to have played all over it, missed it  and the stumps are disturbed, a bad day for the South African legend comes to an end
slower outside the off stump and Kallis cannot get it off the square, gets it straight to the covers fielder
shorter in length and JK pats it back to the bowler, who dives to his left to field that one
edged and through that third slipper, he opens the face almost deliberately but does get it in the gap, the fielder dives to his right but cannot field it properly
shorter in length, bit of movement away and he wants to cut it away, does not get it off the middle and it rolls over to point
shorter, quicker and he is on his back foot, defending at it to the leg side
opens the face of the bat and runs it through to third-man for a single

moves across to the off side and was looking to nudge it away, hits his pads and rolls through the left of the keeper, they get a couple and come back for the third, which is a tightly-taken run, but the ball is not collected cleanly on its return
ooh, that does not come up too much, it was outside the off stump and he was looking to tap it through the covers, gets an inside edge
shorter in length, outside the off stump and that's tapped to the mid-on fielder
shorter in length and tucked away to the leg side for a single
fuller and slower and he looks to get his bat and pad out and push it to the covers, not for runs

outside edge through to third-man for a single, was a quick ball and there was a slip in place too but he was where the third slip would have been and the ball goes in the gap between him and the keeper
shorter in length from over the wicket, was on his pads and tucks it round the corner for a single

big, big appeal and it's given! it was fuller on the middle stump and swinging back into the batsman, he was looking to flick it away to the leg side, missed the bat and hits the pads, the appeal is upheld and Pune have the first blood
shorter and on the leg stump line, going further down and the pull shot does not materialise, what does is a wide
gets his line back to the middle stump, defended back to the bowler
and again, this is poor stuff from Pune, down the leg side and wides again, beats Uthappa and rolls away for five wides, this time the keeper was not up to the stumps and stills beats him
shortens his length and GG taps it to backward point for a single
fuller outside the off stump and GG wants to drive it through the off side but it's a bit too full and digs it back to the bowler
shorter in length and outside the off stump, he looks to guide it to third-man but hits it a tad squarer and to the backward point fielder
on the pads and flicked away neatly to deep square-leg for three
brings his line back closer to the batsman, wants to cut it away, cuts it away to the off side
no, no, no, wide ball outside the off but what makes it worse is the keeper standing up to it and missing it, goes away for five wides
outside the off stump, shorter too and he wanted to cut it away, not too much pace on it, gets it away to the off side
on his pads, bit of swing down and it hits his pads, runs away to the leg side
